1389-gobseck.title: Gobseck
1389-gobseck.creator: Honore De Balzac
1389-gobseck.description: A book by Honore De Balzac. Listen, child, and if you have any confidence in my love, let me guide you in life. At seventeen one cannot judge of past or future, nor of certain social considerations. I have only one thing to say to you. de Restaud has a mother, a mother who would waste millions of francs; a woman of no birth, a Mlle. Goriot; people talked a good deal about her at one time.

26153-the-last-of-the-legions-and-other-.title: The Last Of The Legions And Other Tales Of Long Ago
26153-the-last-of-the-legions-and-other-.creator: Unknown
26153-the-last-of-the-legions-and-other-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Pontus, the Roman viceroy, sat in the atrium of his palatial villa by the Thames, and he looked with perplexity at the scroll of papyrus which he had just unrolled. Before him stood the messenger who had brought it, a swarthy little Italian, whose black eyes were glazed with want of sleep, and his olive features darker still from dust and sweat.

26442-true-to-his-home-a-tale-of-the-boy.title: True To His Home A Tale Of The Boyhood Of Franklin
26442-true-to-his-home-a-tale-of-the-boy.creator: Unknown
26442-true-to-his-home-a-tale-of-the-boy.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. rue spirit of the leaders in our War for Independence is pictured in this dramatic story. It includes the Boston Tea Party and Bunker Hill; and Adams, Hancock, Revere, and the boys who bearded General Gage, are living characters in this romance of American patriotism.

arxiv-2004-06747.title: Extending Text Informativeness Measures to Passage Interestingness Evaluation
arxiv-2004-06747.creator: Carlos-Emiliano González-Gallardo, Eric SanJuan, Juan-Manuel Torres-Moreno
arxiv-2004-06747.description: Abstract Standard informativeness measures used to evaluate Automatic Text Summarization mostly rely on n-gram overlapping between the automatic summary and the reference summaries. These measures differ from the metric they use (cosine, ROUGE, Kullback-Leibler, Logarithm Similarity, etc.) and the bag of terms they consider (single words, word n-grams, entities, nuggets, etc.).

arxiv-2110-05708.title: Nearly optimal quantum algorithm for generating the ground state of a free quantum field theory
arxiv-2110-05708.creator: Mohsen Bagherimehrab, Yuval R. Sanders, Dominic W. Berry, Gavin K. Brennen, Barry C. Sanders
arxiv-2110-05708.description: Abstract We devise a quasilinear quantum algorithm for generating an approximation for the ground state of a quantum field theory (QFT). Our quantum algorithm delivers a super-quadratic speedup over the state-of-the-art quantum algorithm for ground-state generation, overcomes the ground-state-generation bottleneck of the prior approach and is optimal up to a polylogarithmic factor.

arxiv-2112-14933.title: RheFrameDetect : A Text Classification System for Automatic Detection of Rhetorical Frames in AI from Open Sources
arxiv-2112-14933.creator: Saurav Ghosh, Philippe Loustaunau
arxiv-2112-14933.description: Abstract . Rhetorical Frames in AI can be thought of as expressions that describe AI development as a competition between two or more actors, such as governments or companies. Examples of such Frames include robotic arms race , AI rivalry , technological supremacy , cyberwarfare dominance and 5G race .

arxiv-2202-00239.title: Stretching of a fractal polymer around a disc reveals KPZ scaling
arxiv-2202-00239.creator: Kirill E. Polovnikov 1 , Sergei K. Nechaev 2 , Alexander Y. Grosberg 3
arxiv-2202-00239.description: Abstract While stretching of a polymer along a flat surface is hardly different from the classical Pincus problem of pulling chain ends in free space, the role of curved geometry in conformational statistics of the stretched chain is an exciting open question.

arxiv-2204-03210.title: Early Evolution of a Newborn Magnetar with Strong Precession Motion in GRB 180620A
arxiv-2204-03210.creator: Le Zou, En-Wei Liang
arxiv-2204-03210.description: Abstract The observed early X-ray plateau in the afterglow lightcurves of some gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) is attributed to the dipole radiations (DRs) of a newborn magnetar. A quasi-periodic oscillation (QPO) signal in the plateau would be strong evidence of the magnetar precession motion.

arxiv-2310-19181.title: From Chatbots to PhishBots? - Preventing Phishing scams created using ChatGPT, Google Bard and Claude
arxiv-2310-19181.creator: Sayak Saha Roy, Poojitha Thota, Krishna Vamsi Naragam, Shirin Nilizadeh
arxiv-2310-19181.description: Abstract The advanced capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) have made them invaluable across various applications, from conversational agents and content creation to data analysis, research, and innovation. However, their effectiveness and accessibility also render them susceptible to abuse for generating malicious content, including phishing attacks. This study explores the potential of using four popular commercially available LLMs, i.e.

arxiv-2405-20001.title: Prospect of measuring the top quark mass through energy correlators
arxiv-2405-20001.creator: Meng Xiao, Yulei Ye, and Xinyu Zhu
arxiv-2405-20001.description: Abstract Reaching a high precision of the top quark mass is an important task of the Large Hadron Collider. We perform a feasibility study of measuring the top quark mass through the three-point energy correlator. The expected sensitivity of the top quark mass in the boosted regime is presented.

Evaluating Interventions for Appropriate Reliance on Large Language Models DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 CCS: Information systems Information systems applications CCS: Human-centered computing Interaction design process and methods CCS: Human-centered com
arxiv-2412-15584.creator: Jessica Y. Bo, Sophia Wan, Ashton Anderson
arxiv-2412-15584.description: Abstract . As Large Language Models become integral to decision-making, optimism about their power is tempered with concern over their errors. Users may over-rely on LLM advice that is confidently stated but wrong, or under-rely due to mistrust. Reliance interventions have been developed to help users of LLMs, but they lack rigorous evaluation for appropriate reliance.

arxiv-2505-11682.title: Mollifier Layers: Enabling Efficient High-Order Derivatives in Inverse PDE Learning
arxiv-2505-11682.creator: Ananyae Kumar Bhartari, Vinayak Vinayak, Vivek B Shenoy
arxiv-2505-11682.description: Abstract Parameter estimation in inverse problems involving partial differential equations (PDEs) underpins modeling across scientific disciplines, especially when parameters vary in space or time. Physics-informed Machine Learning (PhiML) integrates PDE constraints into deep learning, but prevailing approaches depend on recursive automatic differentiation (autodiff), which produces inaccurate high-order derivatives, inflates memory usage, and underperforms in noisy settings.

arxiv-2509-07502.title: Social Media Clones: Exploring the Impact of Social Delegation with AI Clones through a Design Workbook Study
arxiv-2509-07502.creator: Jackie Liu, Mehrnoosh Sadat Shirvani, Hwajung Hong, Ig-Jae Kim, Dongwook Yoon
arxiv-2509-07502.description: Abstract . ABSTRACT Social media clones are AI-powered social delegates of ourselves created using our personal data. As our identities and online personas intertwine, these technologies have the potential to greatly enhance our social media experience. If mismanaged however, these clones may also pose new risks to our social reputation and online relationships.

arxiv-2602-05100.title: Rule-Based Spatial Mixture-of-Experts U-Net for Explainable Edge Detection
arxiv-2602-05100.creator: Bharadwaj Dogga, Kaaustaaub Shankar, Gibin Raju, Wilhelm Louw, Kelly Cohen
arxiv-2602-05100.description: Abstract Deep learning models like U-Net and its variants, have established state-of-the-art performance in edge detection tasks and are used by Generative AI services world-wide for their image generation models. However, their decision-making processes remain opaque, operating as "black boxes" that obscure the rationale behind specific boundary predictions.

pmc-12542140.title: Beckwith-Wiedemann spectrum (BWSp): an update on diagnosis, management, and follow-up from the scientific committee of the Italian BWSp association
pmc-12542140.creator: Silvia Russo, Donatella Milani, Camilla Meossi, Lorenzo Marcucci, Roberta Pajno, Niccolò Butti, Guido Cocchi, Pierpaola Tannorella, Monica Bertoletti, Diana Carli, Maria Costanza Meazzini, Chiara Tortora, Mario Ferrari, Giuseppe Zampino, Stefania Massuras, Giovanni Battista Ferrero, Paola Quarello,
pmc-12542140.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Beckwith-Wiedemann spectrum (BWSp) is a congenital imprinting disorder characterized by overgrowth, cancer predisposition, and diverse clinical manifestations, resulting from epigenetic and genetic alterations at chromosome 11p15.5. BWSp represents the most common imprinting disorder, with a prevalence exceeding 1:10,000. The disorder is primarily associated with loss or gain of methylation at imprinting control regions IC2 and IC1, paternal uniparental disomy of 11p15, or pathogenic variants in CDKN1C. Advances in molecular diagnostics have refined genotype–phenotype correlations, improving both clinical management and tumor screening protocols.

pmc-13076866.title: Valorization of coal fly ash into a magnetic Fe₃O₄-decorated composite for Cu(II) removal from aqueous systems
pmc-13076866.creator: Sulistyo Saputro, Lina Mahardiani, Mohammad Masykuri, Sri Yamtinah, Amun Amri, Cindy Enrica Novitasari, Tiwi Srilingi, Cinthia Cinthia
pmc-13076866.description: Coal fly ash is generated in large quantities by coal-fired power plants and is commonly disposed of as waste despite containing reactive mineral phases. This study investigates the valorization of coal fly ash into a magnetic Fe₃O₄-decorated composite for Cu(II) removal from aqueous systems, linking waste reutilization with the development of low-cost and magnetically recoverable materials for water treatment.

uslaw-usc-t49-s24101.title: 49 U.S.C. § 24101 — Findings, mission, and goals
uslaw-usc-t49-s24101.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s24101.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Part C (Passenger Transportation); Chapter 241 (General). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Findings.— (1) Public convenience and necessity require that Amtrak, to the extent its budget allows, provide modern, cost-efficient, and energy-efficient intercity rail passenger transportation throughout the United States. (2) Rail passenger transportation can help alleviate overcrowding of airways and airports and on highways.
